lines.en: : Surprise! It’s me again. Not whoever that cutie walking down the hall just now was.
: Did you miss me?
: Just kidding. I obviously know you miss me. It’s written all over your face — which looks pretty great for how old you’ve gotten in my...prolonged absence.
: Do you like my costume? I was going for “ghost” but I couldn’t find a sheet that was white enough.
: Thankfully, this pretty dress was on sale at the thrift store around the block from my house in purgatory.
: Or was it Heaven? I can’t really remember which one is which anymore. They all start blurring together after you get hit by a car.
: Oh, and I added this little boob window myself. All these years later and I’m still handy with a pair of scissors. Who would have known?
: Well?
: What do you think?
: Do you think this is funny?
: Funny? What do you mean?
: Showing up like this? Putting on a costume like you’re actually here with the rest of the girls? Does this make you happy?
: Hey don’t be mad at me. It’s not like I wanted to die. Well, no more than anyone else I mean.
: But, if it were up to me, we’d be on a beach in Cancun right now. Are you really going to throw a temper tantrum just because I look a little different than you’re accustomed to?
: Because, if that’s the case, imagine how I feel. The Aki-kun I knew best still had a tiny little baby dick. And the one you’ve got now would probably tear straight through my cervix.
: Get out.
: And go where? The purgatorial-slash-heavenly thrift shop is closed on holidays and Ami is playing with her friends right now. Are you saying you don’t want to spend time with me?
: I’m saying you should leave. You’re good at that, aren’t you?
: Oh, come on. Give me a break, Akira. I’m just trying to make the best of a shitty situation and you’re making it seem like some kind of haunting.
: Because that’s what it is!
: You keep showing up! You’re supposed to be gone!
: Now I’m just confused. You want me to leave, but you’re sad that I’m gone?
: I’m not sad! I’m fine! I’ve been great since you’ve left!
: I’ll say. You’ve got quite the little harem now, don’t you?
: Though, it’s not without its errors.
: All things considered, I think you’ve been taking things a little too slow.
: Just imagine how many boys I’d have had by now if our roles were reversed and you were the one who died in an accident.
: Why, I’d barely get any sleep.
: Sometimes I wish that’s what would have happened.
: You wish that I’d get fucked by a group of twenty teenage boys? You should know very well just how much stamina they have at that age, Aki-kun.
: I wish it was me.
: That got fucked by a group of twenty teenage boys?
: That died.
: And you don’t think that’s sad?
: I don’t know what it is. But I don’t know how I’m ever supposed to get better if you keep doing this.
: Who says you need to get better? As far as I’m concerned, you’re as close to perfect as they come.
: That’s why you were always my favorite. And that’s why I’m “haunting” you and no one else.
: Who’s that? She looks young. Even for your tastes.
: ...Her name is Sana.
: Cute butt.
: You know she’s awake, right?
: What?
: I mean she’s only pretending to be asleep right now. Probably because she’s getting off on the fact that she’s vulnerable and alone with her handsome teacher.
: Do you have a boner?
: Can I see it?
: Just tell me what you want so you can go back to leaving me alone until it’s fun for you to show up and torment me again.
: I want to see your boner, Aki-kun. I literally just told you that. Come show Mommy how much you’ve grown.
: That’s not why you’re here, Sekai.
: There’s more to it than that.
: Because there’s always more to it than that.
: Even before you were gone, I could never figure out what you were really after.
: It was always a game to you. And I was nothing more than another piece in it, just like everyone else.
: Is that how you really feel?
: Yes. But I’m not about to spend what little time we have together reminding you for the ten millionth time that I do love you. I always did and I always will.
: If you don’t want to accept that, that’s your problem. Not mine.
: I’m well aware that it’s my problem. You’re just not helping and I already have enough going on today without you being involved.
: I know. I’ve been watching. I’m always watching. That’s how the whole “being dead” thing works.

: But that’s exactly what I want to talk to you about, Aki-kun. It would be so easy to make all of that go away. And yet, here you are, completely worthless and flopping around like a fish out of water.
: You realize summer’s almost over, don’t you? And that the next season is right around the corner?
: Did you remember to do your homework?
: What homework? What are you talking about?
: You know exactly what I’m talking about. You were even reminded a couple hours ago.
: You’re supposed to take something that doesn’t belong to you or bad things are going to happen. That’s what all those voices told you, right?
: Those aren’t real.
: What is real then? Because, to me, it seems like you’ve been grappling with that exact question from the moment you woke up. And your answer keeps changing.
: So tell me what it will take for you to change your answer this time. Let your teacher help you with your homework if you can’t finish it yourself.
: Why? What do you even have to gain from this?
: Nothing. I’m destined to swim forever through the rivers of the dead and, so long as you exist, there will always be an inlet leading me right back into you.
: I want to help because I care.

: Do you really think I’d leave someone like you alone on purpose? You were totally helpless without me. And you’d be totally helpless now if Ami hadn’t taken up the mantle of Aki-kun’s red-headed crutch.
: Ami is nothing like you.
: Jeez. I know lying to yourself is kind of your whole thing, but the fact that you were able to say that one without even batting an eye is really impressive.
: You-
: Listen. Beating around the bush isn’t going to have any sort of impact on me, but if you don’t take what I’m about to say seriously, you could lose everything. And I mean everything.
: Give in to those voices. Those urges.
: Stop trying to be a big, strong boy and accept that some people are just weaker than others. You’re one of those people, Aki-kun. You’re not meant to be brave.
: You don’t have what it takes to grab life by the balls and yank them off. All you can do is submit.
: And, as your stand-in mother figure slash previously-living human onahole, I feel as if it is my duty to inform you that the path you’ve “chosen” is wrong.
: You need to do this. And you need to do it quickly because your time is almost up.
: Take something that doesn’t belong to you.
: I can’t do that...
: Sure you can. You already did it once.
: Wait...Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait!
: Don’t tell me you actually tricked yourself into believing that was all just in your head?!
: That...
: Hahaha! Hahahahahahah! Aaahhhahahahah! Oh God! My sides! My sides! I’m gonna die!
: Oh. Wait. I’m already dead.
: That was so funny I nearly forgot.
: That didn’t happen...she...I...

: God, can you seriously just get over that already? It’s really not that big of a deal. Plus, if you want to get super technical, you’ve been raping basically everyone and everything this whole time, Aki-kun.

: Girls at this age are so horny and confused that they can’t even figure out what they’re really after until their hormones have already started to die down. That’s why I prefer boys. They last longer.
: Take this one for example. I don’t know much about her. But, from the way she’s sitting here with her ass out and her eyes open, I’m pretty sure she’s waiting for you to hop on and take a ride.
: So, what are you waiting for? Consent? Does that really change anything at her age?
: If...wait...
: If I already...then...why do I...
: If you’re trying to ask why you have to “take” something else when you’ve already “taken” something once, the answer is much simpler than you think.
: It’s for someone else this time.
: But you better hurry. Because if you wait any longer, you might not be “taking” anything at all. And it would really suck to see all of your hard work go to waste because of a technicality.
: Also, don’t kid yourself, Aki-kun. I can tell just by looking at this girl that you’ve probably wanted her for...
: For...
: Come to think of it, it would probably be more like this. She’s tiny and you’re a big boy now. I wonder how much it will hurt?
: Get out...
: Okay! But don’t say I didn’t warn you when you chicken out and poor whatsername has to wait aeons after aeons for her beloved Aki-kun to come back.
: Or maybe...something even worse?
: Who knows?
: In the words of late, great Kurt Vonnegut Jr. — “Live by the foma that make you brave and kind and-”
: Get out.
: Wait, you didn’t let me finish my quote! “Live by the foma that-”
: Get out. Now.
: Ugh. You know, you were so much nicer before my body was torn into shreds.
: Now.
: Fine, jeez. Guess I’ll just go back to being a stupid ghost and come see you again when you wake up on the right side of the bed.
: After my brother died...
: My mom did the same thing.
: She still saw him...talked to him...
: But one day, that stopped. And then she wasn’t able to talk about him at all.
: I still feel like she sees him sometimes. And just doesn’t tell me about it because she thinks I’ll worry.
: And she’s right...I would.
: I do.
: But I get it.
: And I kind of wish...I could see him too.
: So...you were awake after all?
: Yeah.
: Why?
: I think something is wrong with me.
: No matter what I do, I keep...burning up.
: Nothing makes it stop. Nothing calms it down. And most of the time, nothing even distracts me anymore.
: I wonder if this is how she felt back then? Why she chose to be with her teacher instead of waiting for someone closer to her age.
: What are you saying, Sana?
: Come here.
: Come closer.
: A long time ago, I told you something about triangles.
: Do you remember what it was?
: No...I can’t remember anything right now.
: I think I’m going insane.
: Good.
: I don’t want you to remember.
: I want you to forget everything you know about me.
: And I want to start over.
: Can we do that?
: I don’t want to.
: Is it because you’re not attracted to me?
: It’s because I don’t want to forget you. You’re important to me now.
: Then let me make you feel better.
: Let’s make each other feel better.
: Give me your hand.
: Good boy.
